desc: Parse input and store people's paths. Normalize so $S < T$ by swapping and tracking direction (Up/Down).
Implement a function to check if two people conflict based on their path intervals and directions.
Implement an efficient sweep-line algorithm to compute $R_{max}[i]$ for all $i$.
Build a Sparse Table or Segment Tree over the $R_{max}$ array to support range minimum queries.
For each query $(L, R)$, query the minimum of $R_{max}$ in $[L, R]$. If the minimum is $> R$, output Yes, else No.
Optimize conflict detection to $O(M \log M)$ using a sweep-line and Segment Tree for large inputs.
